name: llama.cpp issue #28211: HIP/ROCm on gfx1151 produces wrong logits (not a crash) for prompts longer than n_ubatch
notes: Minimal public-API reproducer that decodes the same prompt twice differing only in n_ubatch. BF16 also affected (84.7476 vs 13.8167 on Vulkan), which rules out the quantized-matmul kernel as the cause.
